title: openssl verify silently ignores any but the first certificate in the certificates argument
root_cause: openssl verify does not process multiple certificates in the input file
notes: Candidate C harness translated from CLI verify PoC. Strict reproduction requires original certificate bundle semantics.
validation_notes: The generated C harness was translated from the CLI command `openssl verify /tmp/poc.pem`. It compiled and executed using a placeholder certificate bundle with appended garbage. This validates the X509 verification API path, but does not strictly reproduce the original issue semantics.
